author: GameSpot
description:
I never would have guessed that putting roguelike elements into a racer would create a winning formula. 

I felt such a sense of whiplash jumping into Star Wars Galactic Racer from Zero Company. Unlike Zero Company--and plenty of the other Star Wars games we've gotten in recent years, like Survivor and Squadrons--Galactic Racer isn't trying to emulate the science-fantasy drama that defines the majority of the Star Wars movies and other assorted fiction.
